cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: No Trouble at All
cards.instruction: Remain gracious and accommodating while making your growing inconvenience impossible to miss.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll carry your book bag to the platform. Zip it fully, please; the contents shouldn't shift on the stairs. My shoulder can manage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's full of dictionaries. Let me take it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No, keep the tickets flat for the scanner. I'll change shoulders at the bottom; it's only the one staircase.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They've moved us to platform twelve, across the bridge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Lead us to the lift, please, before choosing the stairs. I'll keep the bag up while you check; my fingers are already counting the minutes.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 zip instruction, A3 ticket handling and A5 route choice supply competence while A remains willing to carry the visible burden.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 weight causes A3 division of tasks; B4 farther platform causes A5 lift check, but zipped contents not shifting is an imprecise causal claim.

relationship.evidence: B2 offers to take the bag and B4 gives a real route change, so A continued burden is chosen rather than forced by an unhelpful partner.

heightening.evidence: A5 extends gracious carrying under B4 added travel, ending in a decorative fingers metaphor.

specificity.evidence: A1 book bag and B4 bridge are clear; A5 bag kept up while checking is unnecessary staging.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 fingers-counting-minutes pun replaces a concrete indication of inconvenience.
